name: [BARU] Tawuran Max
desc:
🤝 SISTEM TEAM/ALIANSI
Main bareng temen, saling lindungi di medan perang!

!maketeam/!mt - bikin team, kamu jadi leader
!invite <nama>/!inv - invite player (semua member boleh)
!accept/!acc - terima invite (30 detik)
!decline/!dec - tolak invite
!teamlist/!tl - buka/tutup list anggota
!kickteam <nama>/!kt - leader kick anggota
!leaveteam/!lt - keluar team (leader baru otomatis dipilih)
!disbandteam/!dt - leader bubarin team

✨ Sesama team GAK BISA saling damage/knockback!
